subject: Request: cross-region TTL enforcement + deletion trace for SOC2 evidence
messages:
From: Ellen Park <ellen.park@first-fidelity.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.ai>
Cc: Audit Team <audit.team@first-fidelity.com>
Date: Fri, 10 Apr 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: SOC2 request: TTL enforcement + cross-region deletion proof

Diego,

We're preparing for our SOC2 readiness assessment next month and need to collect evidence for retention and deletion controls that impact our integration with Redwood. Specifically, can you provide:

- A sample export showing TTL enforcement for a tenant record (include timestamps and the pipeline that triggered deletion).
- Cross-region deletion logs proving that when a tenant in eu-west is deleted we remove replicas in other regions within the stated SLA.
- A short description (1-page) of the deletion orchestration flow and where immutable backups are considered in scope.

We'd like to receive artifacts (redacted is fine) by Apr 15. If there's a runbook or playbook for generating these artifacts, please point us to it.

Thanks,
Ellen Park
Senior Compliance Manager
First Fidelity Bank

--
attachment: evidence_request_template.xlsx (manifest)

From: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.ai>
To: Ellen Park <ellen.park@first-fidelity.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 10 Apr 2027 16:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SOC2 request: TTL enforcement + cross-region deletion proof

Hi Ellen — thanks for the clear list. I've looped in Monica (Customer Success) for tenant-level artifacts and Jonas (Security/Infra) for the cross-region proof.

Quick plan:
- We'll produce a TTL enforcement sample CSV (redacted tenant id) showing create -> expire -> deletion timestamps and the worker run that removed the object.
- Jonas will export the cross-region replication/deletion trace for a recent deletion test and annotate the segment that shows replica teardown.
- I'll attach a 1-page deletion orchestration summary and the internal playbook references.

Two clarifying Qs so we provide the exact format you need: 1) Do you want a single zipped artifact, or separate files uploaded to the Drive link? 2) Is there a specific time window for the sample (e.g., last 90 days) or is a single synthetic test OK?

Targeting Apr 13 delivery so you can review before Apr 15.

Best,
Diego Fernandez
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

--
attachment: none

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.ai>, Ellen Park <ellen.park@first-fidelity.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 11 Apr 2027 09:21:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SOC2 request: TTL enforcement + cross-region deletion proof

Thanks, Diego. Ellen — we can provide both: a zipped bundle and the individual files in the shared Drive. For SOC2 auditors, a single zipped package with a short index is usually easiest.

For the TTL artifact, I'll include:
- ttl-enforcement-sample.csv (columns: tenant_id_redacted, object_key, created_at, ttl_seconds, deletion_enqueued_at, deletion_completed_at, deleting_worker_id)
- erasure-playbook-v1.2.pdf (internal runbook excerpt that auditors can review)

For scope: a synthetic test is acceptable if we include production-like timestamps, but we prefer to provide a real sample from the last 30 days with tenant id redacted. If First Fidelity prefers a synthetic sandbox run, we can run that and flag it in the index.

Markus — looping you because auditors sometimes ask for attestation text about backup retention windows and immutable backups; do we want to provide a standard attestation or route that through Legal?

Monica Patel
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference

--
attachment: erasure-playbook-v1.2.pdf

From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
To: Ellen Park <ellen.park@first-fidelity.com>, Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2027 08:14:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SOC2 request: TTL enforcement + cross-region deletion proof

Ellen, Diego — attached is the cross-region deletion trace export and a short technical note. Highlights: 

- The export (cross-region-deletion-log-20270409.json.gz) contains event lines showing the deletion request propagation to us-east-1, eu-west-1, and ap-south-1. Each event includes a request_id, timestamp, region, and result (SUCCESS/FAIL + retry).
- In our observed runs, final replica teardown completed within 18 minutes for the example tenant in eu-west (well within our 2-hour SLA for cross-region replica removal).
- Immutable backups are excluded from automatic tenant deletion; we record backup retention periods and have a separate manual approval flow for backup disposition. That exclusion is documented in the erasure-playbook PDF.

If auditors need a summarized timeline CSV, say so and I can generate one with the annotated hops.

Jonas Weber
Security Engineering Lead | Redwood Inference

--
attachment: cross-region-deletion-log-20270409.json.gz

From: Ellen Park <ellen.park@first-fidelity.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SOC2 request: TTL enforcement + cross-region deletion proof

Team — this is great, thank you. A couple quick asks from the audit team after a preliminary review: 

1) Please include an index.txt in the zip that maps filenames to the exact control objectives they satisfy (e.g., CC3.1: deletion pipeline evidence; CC4.2: replica removal timeline).
2) For the backup exclusion, can you provide a single-line attestation from Redwood leadership confirming the policy and the escalation path for backup destruction? A short email from a delegated approver is fine.

If you can drop the zipped bundle and Drive link by EOD Apr 13, we'll slot this into our evidence package. Thanks again — this is moving fast but looks on track.

Regards,
Ellen Park
Senior Compliance Manager
First Fidelity Bank

--
